component.name: XTA Native
component.summary: XTA's X reader written in Kotlin, a prototype to compare with XTA

description.p: XTA Native is XTA, the private, read-oriented way to browse X, written again in Kotlin to compare with it. It reads X and other sources, such as Bluesky, Mastodon, Reddit, Substack and RSS feeds, and never posts, likes or shares anything in your name. The accounts you follow, your groups, saved posts and likes stay on this computer, apart from XTA's.

ul.li: Timelines of the accounts you follow, in groups you arrange
Saved posts with notes, offline articles and downloads
No trackers: XTA Native talks only to the sites you read
